name: Lish Perevodchik?
source:
Seventeen-year-old Semyon is an ordinary student at a Russian school, who lived a boring and lonely life until one single day... This is the unusual story of two teenagers. Or is it not just two?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1820171813]Steam[/url]]
